question: Do you know whether the 3707 resistor-terminator cards use a different contact scheme? FX061 block AB visibly labels separate inputs A09, B09, C09 and E09; the SLT manual describes its S06AV circuit as 100-ohm resistor terminators.
raw_answer: That could well be the case, I don't know.
interpretation: Different contact scheme is possible but unconfirmed. Preserve literal 3707 labels; do not infer an exemption or force replacements.
